subject: Following up: security packet shared — any blockers or timeline changes for Benton Labs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Rivera <amelia@bentonlabs.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + security packet (next steps)

Hi Amelia — great to meet this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: Replace current on-prem inference stack for your customer-facing document search use case to cut inference costs ~40% while staying within your latency SLOs (<=200ms P50 for 1–2k qps).
- Primary concerns you raised: SOC 2 evidence, data residency for EU customers (we discussed VPC option), and integration effort with your ingestion pipeline.

What I’ll do:
- Share our SOC 2 Type II summary and a short security design doc (attached).
- Set up a 30-min technical review between your security lead and our solutions engineer (Ben) if helpful.

What I need from you:
- Any hard blockers (procurement, legal timelines, or compliance reviews) that would change your priority for Q3.
- A best-guess timeline for security review and procurement (even a week-range is helpful).

Attachments: security packet stubs attached — redwood_soc2_type2_summary.pdf, redwood_security_design.md

If it helps, I’m available for a quick 15-min call Friday morning to walk through any part of the packet.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

From: Amelia Rivera <amelia@bentonlabs.io>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bentonlabs.io>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + security packet (next steps)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the recap and the packet. I’ve looped in Samir (procurement) and we’ll get our security team to review the docs this week.

Quick note: our security lead is on PTO until next Wed, so review may be delayed — I’ll keep you posted on any questions. Please leave the 15-min slot open in case we need a walkthrough.

Best,
Amelia
Director of Product, Benton Labs
amelia@bentonlabs.io

Subject: Checking in — any blockers on the security packet review?

Amelia — just a quick ping since I haven’t heard back in a bit. Wanted to check:

- Is the security packet you received sufficient for the initial review, or are there additional artifacts your team needs (e.g., encryption-at-rest keys, network diagrams, or SOC 2 evidence excerpts)?
- Has the priority/timeline for this project shifted on your side? If procurement is deprioritized for Q3 we can pause follow-ups — just want to be aligned.

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-min walkthrough between your security lead and Ben next Tue/Thu — happy to be flexible.

Thanks,
Jordan

Samir and I will try to lock a time for that walkthrough — leaning toward Wed afternoon PT. I’ll confirm availability tomorrow.

Appreciate the patience — will be in touch soon.

—Amelia
